newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Bondes rates rise at auction. [corrected 02:32 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Mexico Bondes rates rise at auction. [corrected 02:32 gmt]

text.p: The rate on Mexican government 364-day development bonds, or Bondes, rose 0.19 percentage points to 1.68 percent above the 28-day Cetes rate in Tuesday's primary auction, dealers estimated.
The 364-day Bondes were assigned at 98.55609 pesos.
Demand for the one-year Bondes was 1.045 billion pesos, compared with the 500 million offered by the Banco de Mexico.
The rate on the 728-day development bondes fell 0.08 percentage points to 1.78 percent above the 28-day Cetes rate.
The 728-day Bondes were assigned at 97.35516 pesos.
Demand for the two-year Bondes was 1.873 billion pesos, compared with the 500 million offered by the Banco de Mexico.
